name: Return Status
query:
SELECT
    gp.date AS "Date:Date:100",
    gp.name AS "Gate Pass:Link/Gate Pass:150",
    gp.direction AS "Direction:Data:80",

    rp_from.full_name AS "Handover To/From:Data:180",
    rp_place.address AS "Handover Place:Data:180",

    gpi.item AS "Item:Data:220",
    gpi.remarks AS "Remarks:Data:100",

    gpi.qty AS "Qty:Float:80",

    gpi.return_qty AS "Returned Qty:Float:100",

    gpi.adjusted_qty AS "Adjusted Qty:Float:100",

    gpi.pending_qty AS "Pending Qty:Float:100",

    CASE
        WHEN gpi.pending_qty = 0 THEN "Closed"

        WHEN gpi.return_qty = 0
             AND IFNULL(gpi.adjusted_qty,0) = 0
        THEN "Pending"

        ELSE "Partially Returned"
    END AS "Status:Data:140"

FROM `tabGate Pass Item` gpi

INNER JOIN `tabGate Pass` gp
    ON gp.name = gpi.parent

LEFT JOIN `tabReception Person` rp_from
    ON rp_from.name = gp.handover_tofrom

LEFT JOIN `tabReception Person` rp_place
    ON rp_place.name = gp.handover_place

WHERE
    gp.docstatus = 1
    AND gpi.is_returnable = 1
    AND gpi.pending_qty > 0

ORDER BY
    gp.date DESC,
    gp.name DESC;
